briefTitle: Clinical Study of Ivonescimab for First-line Treatment of Metastatic NSCLC Patients With High PD-L1

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years old at the time of enrollment
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Age ≥ 18 years old at the time of enrollment

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0 - 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0 - 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Expected life expectancy ≥ 3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable noncerebral lesion according to RECIST 1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologic or cytopathologic evidence of the presence of small cell lung carcinoma for which first-line approved therapies are indicated. For patients with non-squamous histology, actionable driver mutation testing results are required before randomization.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: SCLC exclusion and non-squamous mutation testing prerequisites are not standard typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received any prior therapy for NSCLC in the metastatic setting.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Duplicate of the prior-lines inclusion condition, kept as fuzzy since prior lines max is already covered.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known actionable genomic alterations for which first-line approved therapies are indicated
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Actionable genomic alterations broadly defined do not map to a single typed mutation status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Symptomatic CNS metastases, CNS metastasis ≥ 1.5 cm, CNS radiation within 7 days prior to randomization, potential need for CNS radiation within the first cycle, or leptomeningeal disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The CNS metastasis rule involves symptoms, size cutoffs, radiation washout windows, and leptomeningeal disease, which are not a simple allowedBrainMets status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior systemic treatment for metastatic NSCLC.
